_how_to_add_a_study: Copy the block below (from { to }), paste it at the top of the studies list, add a comma after it, and change the values.
type: Study, Brief, Index, Dataset or Experiment.
ai_assistants: any of ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Google AI Overviews, Google AI Mode, Perplexity, Microsoft Copilot, Meta AI.
topics: short labels. Reuse existing ones when they fit (for example: Med spas, Plastic surgery, Dispensaries, Eye care, Reviews, Citations, Accuracy, Technical AEO).
date: year-month-day, like 2026-11-07. data_url is optional; leave it out if there is no download.

video (optional, add it once the YouTube explainer is live): copy the example below into the study, right after data_url, with a comma before it. youtube = the video's link, length = how long it runs (like 1:04), uploaded = the day it went live on YouTube, transcript = paste YouTube's transcript or your script (put a blank line between paragraphs as \n\n). title and description are optional.
Save (Commit changes). The hub rebuilds itself in about a minute.

studies.title: How Often AI Recommends Your Business: A Better Measure of Local Visibility
studies.short_title: How Often AI Recommends Your Business
studies.summary: Asked the same query twice, Gemini’s sources overlapped by only 0.46 and a median of 29% of the businesses ChatGPT named appeared in both answers, so AI visibility is best measured as how often a business is named across many answers.

studies.title: The Local Answer Gap: what 7,583 Google AI answers reveal about AEO for local businesses
studies.summary: News outlets supplied 67.5% of the citations in Google’s AI answers about local businesses; businesses’ own websites supplied 6.5%, and 83.6% of answers told people to check with their local store.
